_what: lil ships no test or acceptance target: the upstream repository carries ~25 .lil demo scripts and a CLI (main.c), not a suite, and no translation in this study transpiled a driver that exercises them (main.rs is the interactive CLI; it is inlined into the pair as an unscored module for its type aliases only). PROTOCOL.md section 2 therefore gives TEST-UNAVAILABLE for every lil cell and the universe comes from a link-dead-code denominator build (scripts/rq4/denominator.sh, reference call lil_<tool>::lil_new()).
